cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: far · /fɑr/ · adverb · Word · New
at a long distance. Is the park far from here?
distance · /ˈdɪstəns/ · noun · Word · New
The amount of space between two places. What is the distance from here to the park?
nearby · /ˌnɪrˈbaɪ/ · adverb · Word · New
Not far away. Is there a cafe nearby?
how far · /haʊ fɑr/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Used to ask about the distance to a place. How far is the library?
not far from · /nɑt fɑr frəm/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Near a stated place. The park is not far from my home.

Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.

articulation.label: near
articulation.alt: near: /n/ → /ɪ/ → /r/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: am, is and are
sections: Pattern
Use am with I, is with one person or thing, and are with you or more than one. Put is or are first in a question.
